author: Kay Lousberg
notes: Original official glb bytes preserved. Not downloaded from third-party mirrors.
Free release contains running strafes and walking backwards only; does not supply all walk/run directional variants.
Skeleton is stylized Rig_Medium with 23 joints and nonidentity local rest rotations. Must retarget by world rest delta and chain mapping, not name replacement.

Raw running strafes show strong lateral foot travel and torso remains forward-biased, not a forward run with whole root rotated 90 degrees. Foot travel also has forward/back component; validate target foot contact and axis before use.
Both files include skinned mannequin meshes for offline source inspection; do not ship these source visible meshes as runtime motion geometry.
